novel_features.name: Going-dark report
novel_features.description: List members whose most-recent check-in is older than N days (the operator's daily churn signal). Local SQLite join — no PushPress API endpoint computes this.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced customers with their most-recent check-in locally; PushPress has no /v3 endpoint that returns 'members who stopped showing up'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when answering 'who do I need to re-engage' — the daily-churn question every gym owner runs by hand.

novel_features.name: Recency ladder
novel_features.description: Bucket all active members by days-since-last-checkin; emits count + sample of names per bucket.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for the daily KPI dashboard — one histogram of who's still active, who's drifting.

novel_features.name: Trainer roster (one-line default)
novel_features.description: One line per active member: id, name, plan, status, last_visit, days_since. The trainer-dashboard's default view.
novel_features.rationale: Joins synced customers with last check-in locally; the brief explicitly names 'one line per member' as the required default shape.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this from coach prep, trainer-dashboard renders, or any 'list my members' agent task.

novel_features.name: Daily KPI ticker
novel_features.description: One pass over local store: signups today, check-ins today, active members, going-dark @ 14d / 30d. JSON-friendly for cron.
novel_features.rationale: Replaces 4-5 dashboard tabs with one local-aggregation row.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this from a business-dashboard cron job — one row, no parsing.

novel_features.name: Member 360
novel_features.description: Single command: profile + plan/status + first_seen + last_seen + total_checkins + last 10 check-ins + current streak + cadence trend.
novel_features.rationale: Collapses ~5 dashboard clicks; pulls from /v3 customers/{id} plus the local checkins store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before a coaching session, an at-risk-member outreach, or any per-member context an agent needs.

novel_features.name: Class-type mix
novel_features.description: Histogram of class names from local check-ins over a window: counts + percent share per class.
novel_features.rationale: Class names appear inside ClassCheckin records even though /v3 has no class-definition endpoint; we expose the only class-side signal available.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when answering 'what class is most popular this month' or 'which class is bleeding members'.

narrative.headline: Every PushPress /v3 endpoint that exists, plus the going-dark report and the trainer-dashboard one-liner the API itself can't answer.
narrative.value_prop: Wraps PushPress's /v3 Platform API (members, check-ins, app installs, webhooks, messages) with a Go binary that caches every entity in local SQLite and adds the cross-entity views the API doesn't: `going-dark` for daily churn audits, `roster` for the trainer dashboard, `kpi today` for the business cockpit, `member` for coach prep. Five categories absent from /v3 (plans/billing, classes, leads, signup-source, tasks/notes, cancellations) ship as honest gap-flagged commands that point at the documented /v2 follow-up rather than silently dropping.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticates with a PushPress API key. Set it once with `pushpress-pp-cli auth set-token <key>` or `export PUSHPRESS_API_KEY=<key>`. Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Some endpoints also accept an optional `companyId` HEADER for tenant scoping.

quickstart.comment: Save your PushPress API key once.
Verify the key reaches the API and identify which company the key is scoped to.
Populate the local store so going-dark and roster have data.
The headline churn report — members who haven't checked in for 14 days.
One-line metric ticker for a business-dashboard cron.

troubleshoots.fix: Regenerate the API key in the PushPress developer portal and re-run `pushpress-pp-cli auth set-token`.

troubleshoots.symptom: `plans list` / `mrr today` / `cancellations recent` print 'not supported by /v3'
troubleshoots.fix: Expected — these categories aren't in the public /v3 API. Run the documented /v2 browser-sniff follow-up to unlock them.
Run `pushpress-pp-cli sync --full` — these read from the local store, not live API.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for `pp-pushpress` when you need member-attendance signals an agent can act on — going-dark lists for re-engagement, per-member visit history before a coaching session, daily KPI tickers for the dashboard. Skip it for billing or class-definition queries; those need the /v2 follow-up and currently print a 'not supported' message.
